text: Neutral dark theme with a white accent and no green ok: colour only for warning and error, flat opaque panels, weights 400 and 500, and a guard test that enforces it.
Map colour: keepout and slow zones and nav paths keep their colour, POI kinds are greyscale and told apart by shape, all from one palette file.
Docked right sidebar on tablet and desktop that shrinks the map, bottom sheets on phones, and no MapPopup: show on map centres the item and opens it in the sidebar.
One status line, STOP plus STOP GRASP in the toolbar only, a flat agent chat log, a Dialog for destructive actions and the two-click arm for robot motion, with decluttered panels and copy.
